question_text: A government employee wants to appeal a decision of her agency head regarding a promotion. She believes the decision violated civil service rules. Which of the following best describes the role of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) in this situation?

options.text: It acts as the central personnel agency that hears and decides appeals on personnel actions.
It prosecutes the agency head for violating civil service rules.
It provides legal representation to the employee in court.
It sets the salary rates for all government employees.
